rooms.name: Lobby
rooms.description: A quiet hall where your journey begins.

rooms.name: Tutorial
rooms.description: Signs on the wall explain the basic controls.

rooms.name: Narrator's Room
rooms.description: The Narrator greets you and hands you starter gear.

rooms.name: First Path
rooms.description: A stone corridor slopes down into the shelter.

rooms.name: Central Plaza
rooms.description: The heart of the shelter. Shops lie west, the exit north.

rooms.name: Crossroads
rooms.description: A mossy junction. Shops murmur nearby, the woods call west.

rooms.name: Enchanter
rooms.description: A smoky workshop where gear can be imbued with power.

rooms.name: Merchant
rooms.description: A stall packed with wares, watched by a sharp-eyed trader.

rooms.name: Woods Gate
rooms.description: The path splits between the Forest and the Mountain.

rooms.name: Forest Entrance
rooms.description: Twisted trees block most of the light. Something stirs.

rooms.name: Forest Scout
rooms.description: A nervous scout watches over the edge of the forest.

rooms.name: Goblin Clearing
rooms.description: A goblin leaps from the brush, ready to defend its turf.

rooms.name: Hidden Trail
rooms.description: A second, craftier goblin guards a barely visible shortcut.

rooms.name: Forest Camp
rooms.description: An abandoned camp full of loose coins and supplies.

rooms.name: Forest Vault
rooms.description: A reinforced wooden chest rests among tangled roots.

rooms.name: Goblin Chief
rooms.description: The strongest goblin around blocks your way, sneering.

rooms.name: Forest Shrine
rooms.description: The Forest Elder waits by a final chest to honor your feat.

rooms.name: Mountain Pass
rooms.description: A windswept, rocky slope. Huge footprints mark the trail.

rooms.name: Mountain Scout
rooms.description: A scout points nervously toward the ogres above.

rooms.name: Ogre Crossing
rooms.description: A hulking ogre blocks the path, growling among the rocks.

rooms.name: Hidden Crevice
rooms.description: A smaller but fierce ogre guards a crack in the rock.

rooms.name: Mountain Camp
rooms.description: A grateful traveler shares loot for clearing the crevice.

rooms.name: Frozen Vault
rooms.description: A metal chest gleams under the frost of a small cave.

rooms.name: Ogre Chief
rooms.description: The ogre chieftain awaits at the summit, guarding it.

rooms.name: Mountain Shrine
rooms.description: The Mountain Elder waits beside the region's final chest.

rooms.name: Path Guide
rooms.description: A wandering narrator comments on the roads ahead.

rooms.name: Kingdom Gate
rooms.description: Here the road forks toward the Frost and Fire Kingdoms.

rooms.name: Frost Kingdom
rooms.description: A freezing wind sweeps through carved halls of ice.

rooms.name: Frost Sentinel
rooms.description: A sentinel warns you about the wizard ruling these halls.

rooms.name: Frost Wizard
rooms.description: A frost-wrapped wizard hurls icy sparks around you.

rooms.name: Icy Shadow
rooms.description: A frozen shadow glides silently between the ice columns.

rooms.name: Frozen Nook
rooms.description: A small nook holds coins left by earlier adventurers.

rooms.name: Frost Vault
rooms.description: An ice-coated chest glimmers under a faint blue light.

rooms.name: Ice Throne
rooms.description: The Frost Archmage awaits atop a throne of solid ice.

rooms.name: Frost Shrine
rooms.description: The Frost Elder waits by the kingdom's final chest for you.

rooms.name: Fire Kingdom
rooms.description: The heat is stifling. Lava cracks light blackened halls.

rooms.name: Fire Sentinel
rooms.description: An ash-covered sentinel warns of the wizard who rules here.

rooms.name: Fire Wizard
rooms.description: A flame-wrapped wizard hurls burning sparks around you.

rooms.name: Ember Shadow
rooms.description: A burning shadow glides silently between charred pillars.

rooms.name: Ashen Nook
rooms.description: A small nook holds coins left by earlier adventurers.

rooms.name: Fire Vault
rooms.description: A metal chest glows red-hot under an orange light.

rooms.name: Fire Throne
rooms.description: The Fire Archmage awaits atop a throne wreathed in flame.

rooms.name: Fire Shrine
rooms.description: The Fire Elder waits by the kingdom's final chest for you.

rooms.name: Sealed Gate
rooms.description: A huge sealed door with four locks, one per honor earned.

rooms.name: Dragon Fortress
rooms.description: Glowing runes line the walls of a fortress radiating heat.

rooms.name: Council Room
rooms.description: The Narrator appears once more to advise you before the end.

rooms.name: Shade Sentinel
rooms.description: A silent shade rises as the last guardian before the hall.

rooms.name: Goblin Sentinel
rooms.description: A battle-worn goblin veteran guards the final corridor.

rooms.name: Final Gate
rooms.description: A silent guardian checks your honors before you pass.

rooms.name: Dragon's Lair
rooms.description: The air burns and the floor is covered in ash and gold.

apple.name: Apple
apple.description: An apple that restores a little health.

ice_potion.name: Ice Potion
ice_potion.description: A brew that chills whoever drinks it.

fire_potion.name: Fire Potion
fire_potion.description: A potion that burns in your hands.

frost_sword.name: Frost Sword
frost_sword.description: A sword forged in eternal ice.

flame_sword.name: Flame Sword
flame_sword.description: A sword wreathed in living flame.

narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.sentence: Welcome, traveler. Here is what you need to begin.

enchanter.name: Enchanter
enchanter.description: Imbues magical power into your items.

merchant.name: Merchant
merchant.description: Trades in all kinds of goods.

path_guide.name: Path Guide
path_guide.description: Comments on the routes ahead. Optional to talk to.
path_guide.sentence: West lies ice. East lies fire. Beyond, the dragon waits.

council_narrator.name: Elder Narrator
council_narrator.description: Advises the hero just before the final battle.
council_narrator.sentence: You have come far. May your honors open the last door.

gatekeeper.name: Gatekeeper
gatekeeper.description: Checks the hero's honors before granting passage.
gatekeeper.sentence: Your deeds precede you. You may enter the dragon's lair.

forest_scout.name: Forest Scout
forest_scout.description: Watches over the edge of the forest.

quest.name: Clearing the Woods
quest.description: Defeat the goblin lurking in the forest.

dialogues.intro: The woods are no longer safe. I need your help.
dialogues.already_given: The goblin is still out there, hurry.
dialogues.finished: You did it. Take your reward, hero.

forest_wanderer.name: Forest Wanderer
forest_wanderer.description: A survivor who lost his gear in the forest.

quest.name: Lost in the Woods
quest.description: Find a chest key lost in the undergrowth.

dialogues.intro: I lost my supplies in the forest. Find that key for me.
dialogues.finished: Thank you, traveler. Take this as thanks.

forest_elder.name: Forest Elder
forest_elder.description: Watches over the forest's final shrine.
forest_elder.sentence: You proved yourself against the goblins. Well done.

mountain_scout.name: Mountain Scout
mountain_scout.description: Watches the slopes where ogres roam.

quest.name: Clearing the Peak
quest.description: Defeat the ogre blocking the mountain pass.

dialogues.intro: Ogres block the pass. I need someone to face them.
dialogues.already_given: The ogre is still out there, be careful.
dialogues.finished: Impressive. The mountain owes you one.

mountain_wanderer.name: Mountain Wanderer
mountain_wanderer.description: A trader who lost cargo in a crevice.

quest.name: Lost Cargo
quest.description: Find a chest key lost among the rocks.

dialogues.intro: My cargo fell into a crevice. A key should still be there.
dialogues.already_given: Still waiting on news of that key.
dialogues.finished: At last. Take this as a reward.

mountain_elder.name: Mountain Elder
mountain_elder.description: Watches over the mountain's final shrine.
mountain_elder.sentence: You tamed the ogres. The mountain welcomes you.

frost_scout.name: Frost Sentinel
frost_scout.description: Watches the frozen halls of the Frost Kingdom.

quest.name: The Frost Wizard
quest.description: Defeat the wizard ruling the Frost Kingdom.

dialogues.intro: A frost wizard rules these halls. No one has stopped him.
dialogues.already_given: The frost wizard still sits on his throne.
dialogues.finished: You defeated the wizard. The kingdom breathes again.

frost_wanderer.name: Frost Wanderer
frost_wanderer.description: An explorer who lost gear in the ice.

quest.name: Frozen Relic
quest.description: Find a chest key trapped in the ice.

dialogues.intro: My key is trapped in the ice. Help me recover it.
dialogues.already_given: The ice still holds that key.
dialogues.finished: Thanks, this will help you on your journey.

frost_elder.name: Frost Elder
frost_elder.description: Watches over the Frost Kingdom's final shrine.
frost_elder.sentence: You braved the cold and its guardians. Well earned.

fire_scout.name: Fire Sentinel
fire_scout.description: Watches the burning halls of the Fire Kingdom.

quest.name: The Fire Wizard
quest.description: Defeat the wizard ruling the Fire Kingdom.

dialogues.intro: A fire wizard rules these halls. No one has stopped him.
dialogues.already_given: The fire wizard still sits on his throne.
dialogues.finished: You defeated the wizard. The kingdom breathes again.

fire_wanderer.name: Fire Wanderer
fire_wanderer.description: An explorer who lost gear in the embers.

quest.name: Ashen Relic
quest.description: Find a chest key lost among the embers.

dialogues.intro: My key is lost in the embers. Help me recover it.
dialogues.already_given: The embers still hold that key.
dialogues.finished: Thanks, this will help you on your journey.

fire_elder.name: Fire Elder
fire_elder.description: Watches over the Fire Kingdom's final shrine.
fire_elder.sentence: You braved the flames and its guardians. Well earned.
